_about: The values tools/memory-check/check.mjs holds memory to (toolkit-standard §D 25). indexLines and indexBytes are what Claude Code loads of MEMORY.md at a session's start (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md, read 2026-11-26); fileBytes holds a memory file, read whole when it is opened, to the same budget; staleDays is when a dated state section is re-checked before it is relied on; types are the memory types Claude Code documents; sessionDays is when an unnamed (side) session is pruned, liveMinutes how recently a transcript changed for its session to count as running.
